description: Evaluate expressions with trig, logs, powers and factorials.

faqs.a: With a hand-written tokenizer, shunting-yard parser and RPN evaluator — eval() is never used, so arbitrary code cannot run.
It is a percentage: it divides the preceding value by 100. It is not the modulo operator.
The calculator defaults to degrees (DEG). Tap the DEG button to switch to radians if you need radian mode.

howto: Type an expression or tap the pad buttons to build it, e.g. sin(30)+2^3.
Switch between DEG and RAD for the trig functions.
Press = or Enter to evaluate; everything runs locally in your browser.
See past calculations in the history list below the result.
title: Scientific Calculator
